==Mechanics==
[[File:Crafting at Ourania Altar.png|thumb|200px|Players crafting runes at the Ourania Altar.]]
The player is able to craft all runes that are available in the game (except [[combination runes]], [[wrath runes]], and [[sunfire rune]]s), despite not having the required level or [[quest]] requirements. However, the higher the player's [[Runecraft]] level, the higher-levelled the crafted runes will be. The experience here is 1.7 times what players would normally get for each pure essence.

Crafting runes at the Ourania Altar will only result in a single rune per essence, even if the player has reached a level where [[multiple runes]] per essence would be crafted at their regular altars. Additionally, extracts obtained from the [[scar essence mine]] will '''not''' be consumed to grant additional runes. However, some multipliers can be applied to increase the runes per essence obtained. The [[medium Ardougne Diary]] will boost the runes crafted by type. See [[#Ardougne diary|below]] for information about that. Furthermore, wearing the full [[Raiments of the Eye]] set will boost the runes crafted by 60%, in the same way the robes function on regular [[runic altar]]s.

When using [[Daeyalt essence]] at the Ourania Altar, the experience is calculated as <math>1.5 \times 1.7 \times \mathit{BaseXP}</math>

===Ardougne diary===
Completion of the [[medium Ardougne Diary]] adds a chance of crafting an extra rune at the Ourania Altar, though no extra experience is gained. The cloak does not need to be equipped for this to occur.

===Rune distribution===
The distribution of runes given at the Ourania Altar depends on the player's [[Runecraft]] level. There are separate distributions defined for each ten-level band: one for level 1 to 9, another for 10 to 19, 20 to 29, and so on, with level 99 having its own distribution.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/jagexash/status/1312893446395506688|date=4 October 2020|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/o4Xg0|archivedate=5 October 2020|quote=A number up to 10,000 is picked, and compared against the contents of the enclosed table.
E.g. For a player with level 20, values 0-7 would give a soul rune, 8-22 give a blood rune, 23-54 give a death rune, 55-109 give a law rune, etc. [https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EjhU5x4XYAAu2qa?format=png]}}
